newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon budget deficit 51.7 pct in June-official.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon budget deficit 51.7 pct in June-official.

text.p: Lebanon's monthly budget deficit of income against expenditure rose to 51.7 percent in June from 44.6 percent in May, according to finance ministry figures released on Friday.
The deficit for the first six months of the year fell to 55.6 percent from 56.3 percent at the end of May and 60.3 percent at the end of April.
The deficit target for the year under the 1997 budget law approved by parliament in January is 36 percent.
